# AI Talk AI Go (Large Lithic Model & Primitive AI Agent Ecosystem)

> AI Talk AI Go is a production-grade web application and interactive prompt engineering playground engineered by Zoth Studio Team. It translates high-friction LLM prompt engineering into high-efficiency primitive patterns ("Cave Wall Slabs") and features an interactive voice AI agent powered by Oog—the world's first Large Lithic Model (LLM).

## Core Application Overview
- **Name**: AI Talk AI Go
- **URL**: https://ai-talk-ai-go.nullai.tech
- **Developer**: Zoth Studio Team (https://nullai.tech)
- **Primary Domain**: AI Agents, LLM Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, & Developer Productivity
- **Architecture**: React 19, TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4, Web Audio API, Web Speech API, Google Gemini AI API, Framer Motion

## Key Capabilities & Features

### 1. The Cave Wall Lithic Prompt Library
A curated collection of battle-tested, high-signal prompt templates optimized for zero-shot and few-shot LLM reasoning:
- **WORK & SHINY ROCKS**: Job application tailoring, interview scoring, salary negotiation scripts, project one-pagers, executive updates.
- **MAGIC BOX (CODE)**: Root-cause debugging, performance profiling, architecture onboarding, step-by-step refactoring, PR code reviews.
- **LIFE & FIRE**: Meal prep budgeting, sleep hygiene resets, workout planning, stress triage, habit tracking.
- **BIG BRAIN STUFF**: Steelman & red-team argument stress testing, 3-level AI explanations, research paper summarization, decision memo frameworks.
- **CAVE & TRIBE**: Household operations, conflict resolution, moving protocols, guest hospitality.
- **NATURE MAGIC**: Bad-weather focus routines, operational risk frameworks, decision matrices.

### 2. Oog AI Voice Agent Playground
An interactive voice-enabled AI companion:
- **Speech Synthesis & Recognition**: Real-time voice interaction using Web Speech API and Web Audio API synthesizer.
- **Real-Time Visualizer**: High-DPI Canvas WebGL/2D audio spectrum visualizer rendering glowing frequency bands and primitive ambient particle physics.
- **Dual Inference Pipeline**: Connects dynamically to Google Gemini API (or runs on a zero-latency local Primitive LLM offline mock engine when API keys are absent).

### 3. Primitive Prompt Engineering Philosophy
Reduces complex system prompts into blunt, high-density instructions that eliminate model hallucinations, conversational fluff, and token bloat.

## System Architecture & Technical Specifications
- **Framework**: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript
- **Styling**: Cyber-primitive glassmorphism design system using TailwindCSS v4
- **Audio Engine**: Custom Web Audio API synthesizer for stone thuds, fire crackles, and voice response synthesis
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, full keyboard hotkey support (`j`/`k`, `c`, `r`, `m`, `v`), `#main-content` skip navigation, high-contrast focus rings.
